items.title: James "Sing" Miller Interview, 1971-01-17
items.q: Kim was left handed too but he writes right handed.

ctx.x: Well, Sylvester Handy is based... He's left handed but he... The way he plays it, he puts his right hand around backwards somehow or other. You notice? He plays left handed because he's left handed but it's the way he holds the strings by twisting his hand around.
Kim was left handed too but he writes right handed.
He writes right handed, that's right. He writes right handed, that's right. Come to think of it, when he signed my book, I remember...
